question: Can I reset my password by calling the IT hotline?
ground_truth: No. Password reset is self-service at accounts.company.com/reset using mobile OTP. The hotline (ext. 4357) is only for urgent account unlocks.
answer_span: Self-service reset: accounts.company.com/reset

question: Does Jira auto approve for everyone?
ground_truth: No. Jira is auto-approved only for Engineering. Other teams wait 1 business day for approval.
answer_span: Jira / Confluence: Auto-approved for Engineering, 1 day for others

question: My VPN keeps dropping every 20 minutes, what should I change?
ground_truth: Set the MTU to 1300 in VPN advanced settings, disable adapter power saving, use 5GHz Wi-Fi or wired, and reinstall the client if it persists.
answer_span: Set MTU size to 1300

question: How long until I can get AWS console access?
ground_truth: AWS Console needs Security team approval and takes 5-7 days.
answer_span: AWS Console: Security team approval required (5-7 days)

question: My second monitor isn't showing anything
ground_truth: Check the cable at both ends, try another cable/port, run Detect Displays in OS settings, and reboot with the monitor connected.
answer_span: Check cable is firmly connected on both ends

question: I got locked out after typing my password wrong too many times
ground_truth: Accounts lock after 5 failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes for auto-unlock, or contact IT / call ext. 4357 for an urgent unlock.
answer_span: Locks after 5 failed login attempts

question: How often do passwords expire and what are the rules for a new one?
ground_truth: Passwords expire every 90 days. A new password needs at least 12 characters with 1 uppercase letter, 1 number and 1 special character.
answer_span: Passwords expire every 90 days

question: VPN won't connect at all even though my internet works
ground_truth: Use your company email as the username, enter the 6-digit MFA code within 30 seconds, and try a mobile hotspot to rule out a firewall. After 5 failed attempts contact IT.
answer_span: Use your company email as username (not personal)

question: How long does Salesforce access take to get approved?
ground_truth: Salesforce needs manager and department head approval and takes 3-5 days.
answer_span: Salesforce: Manager + department head approval (3-5 days)

question: How do I request access to Figma?
ground_truth: Go to it-portal.company.com, open Access Requests, search for Figma, pick your team and give a one-line reason; your manager approves in about 1 business day (Figma is auto-approved for Design).
answer_span: Go to it-portal.company.com → Access Requests

question: My computer is really sluggish today
ground_truth: Do a full restart, keep at least 10GB of disk free, check Task Manager or Activity Monitor for processes above 80% CPU (Chrome, Zoom, Docker), and run the IT diagnostic tool.
answer_span: Laptop is slow or freezing

question: People on the call can't hear me
ground_truth: In Zoom go to Settings, Audio and choose the correct microphone, and make sure the Zoom app is up to date.
answer_span: Settings → Audio → select correct microphone

question: How do I get into a private Slack channel?
ground_truth: Ask an existing member of the private channel to add you.
answer_span: Private channels: ask an existing member to add you

question: I haven't received any new emails since this morning
ground_truth: Check whether Outlook says Working Offline and turn it off, restart Outlook, and if mail is still missing after 30 minutes remove and re-add the account.
answer_span: If new mail is still missing after 30 minutes

question: What is the mailbox size limit?
ground_truth: The mailbox limit is 50 GB per person.
answer_span: The mailbox limit is 50 GB per person

question: My meetings all appear an hour off
ground_truth: Set your time zone in Outlook calendar settings and make sure the computer's time zone matches; restart Outlook after travelling.
answer_span: Make sure your computer's own time zone setting matches

question: How do I tell people I'm on vacation when they email me?
ground_truth: In Outlook use File, Automatic Replies, set the dates, and write separate messages for internal and external senders.
answer_span: File → Automatic Replies

question: What's the largest file I can attach to an email?
ground_truth: The attachment limit is 25 MB per message; use a OneDrive link for larger files.
answer_span: The attachment limit is 25 MB per message

question: I can't see the team inbox I was added to
ground_truth: Access is requested through the IT portal and can take up to 60 minutes to appear; restart Outlook if it has not shown up after an hour.
answer_span: it can take up to 60 minutes to show up

question: The printer on the 3rd floor says it's offline
ground_truth: Check it is powered on, then remove and re-add the printer by name in system settings; if the whole floor is affected, report it in #it-help with the printer name.
answer_span: Windows: Settings → Printers & scanners

question: Which Wi-Fi should I use for my personal phone in the office?
ground_truth: Use CorpGuest for personal phones and visitors; CorpWiFi is for company laptops.
answer_span: Personal phones and visitors must use CorpGuest

question: Video calls keep freezing in the conference room
ground_truth: Switch to 5GHz, plug into the wired dock port in the room, and report the room and time in #it-help.
answer_span: Every meeting room has a wired dock port

question: How do I connect to the team shared drive on a Mac?
ground_truth: Be on the office network or VPN, then in Finder press Cmd+K and enter smb://fileserver/team.
answer_span: press Cmd+K and enter smb://fileserver/team

question: My Bluetooth headphones won't connect to my laptop
ground_truth: Toggle Bluetooth, remove the headset from paired devices, hold its power button for 5 seconds to enter pairing mode, then pair again and select it in Zoom or Teams.
answer_span: Hold the headset power button for 5 seconds

question: I clicked a link in a weird email, what do I do now?
ground_truth: Change your password straight away at accounts.company.com/reset, call ext. 4357, and report the email with the Report Phish button or to security@company.com.
answer_span: change your password straight away

question: My laptop was taken from my car
ground_truth: Report it within 1 hour to security@company.com and call ext. 4357; IT locks the account and remotely wipes the device, and for theft you also file a police report.
answer_span: Report it within 1 hour to security@company.com

question: I got a new phone and my authenticator codes no longer work
ground_truth: Re-register the new phone at accounts.company.com/mfa with a backup code; without backup codes IT verifies you through your manager, taking up to 4 hours.
answer_span: re-register the new phone using one of your backup codes

question: I got an alert about a sign-in from another country
ground_truth: If it wasn't you, choose This wasn't me, reset your password immediately and tell security@company.com; if it was you while travelling, no action is needed.
answer_span: reset your password immediately and tell security@company.com

question: Can I plug a USB stick into my work laptop?
ground_truth: No. USB storage is blocked by default; use OneDrive, or request an exception with your manager's approval.
answer_span: USB storage is blocked by default to prevent data loss

question: My laptop is asking for a BitLocker recovery key
ground_truth: Sign in with MFA and get the recovery key at it-portal.company.com/recovery; never share it with anyone.
answer_span: find your recovery key at it-portal.company.com/recovery

question: What is the company's parental leave policy?
ground_truth: I don't have information about that. Please contact it-support@company.com

question: Can I expense a standing desk for my home office?
ground_truth: I don't have information about that. Please contact it-support@company.com

question: How do I ask for a salary review?
ground_truth: I don't have information about that. Please contact it-support@company.com

question: What's a good place for lunch near the office?
ground_truth: I don't have information about that. Please contact it-support@company.com
